acv.quote: It would have been about seventy-five K a year.

header.reason: Diane, the CFO, froze all new vendor projects after a missed Q3. Owen had no payback number of Pikeview's own to show her. Renee calls it timing, but that cost case was never built.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with how long a pricing change takes on homegrown billing.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Owen wanted a rebuild because every price change took a quarter, but nothing set a date.
findings.quote: every pricing change takes them a quarter

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Show finance why homegrown billing is urgent, not a nice extra.
findings.why: Diane, the CFO, froze the deal and never met us. She only funds what is on fire.
findings.quote: if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Spell out what keeping homegrown billing costs each year.
findings.why: Renee says the only rival was doing nothing. Near the end, Owen's questions turned to payback for finance.
findings.quote: do you have something that shows payback?

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut 'grow revenue' from the billing pitch.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Owen loved the price-change demo but pushed back when Renee talked about growing revenue.
findings.quote: we're not trying to grow revenue with billing

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a payback example built on one customer's own billing costs.
findings.why: Renee sent the general ROI deck, but Owen needed a Pikeview number to win over Diane.
findings.quote: I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Describe homegrown billing as 'a tax on the roadmap'.
findings.why: Owen used this phrase for his problem, and it ties to the demo he liked most.
findings.quote: stop it being a tax on the roadmap.
